title: MCCDUELS
description: MCCDuels is the official competitive PvP and dueling framework for the ManWorks Network, offering a unified, high‑performance system for Survival, Crystal PvP, and Duels across multi‑server environments.
body:
💎 ManWorks & MCCDuels Official Discord
Welcome to the ManWorks Network — home of MCCDuels (Minecraft Competitive Competition Duels), the official competitive PvP and dueling framework powering the ManWorks ecosystem.
Join our community to connect with developers, players, and network owners who share a passion for high‑performance Minecraft experiences.

⚔️ What We Offer
Competitive PvP support and feedback

Development insights and update logs

Community events, duels, and showcases

Networking with creators and server owners

Early previews of MCCDuels features

🌐 Join the Community

🧱 About MCCDuels
MCCDuels (Minecraft Competitive Competition Duels) is a professional‑grade dueling and PvP framework designed for multi‑server networks.
It powers Survival, Crystal PvP, and Duels through a unified, scalable, and production‑ready architecture built by the ManWorks Team.
